pr_body:
Makes it possible to customize left/right arrow buttons and panels for left/right buttons and tab buttons.

Other changes:
- centers left/right arrow images on left/right buttons thus removing hack necessary for CNC mod
- `AddFactionSuffixLogic` adds suffix to both `TabButton` and `ArrowButton` and also for `Decorations` fields on `ProductionTabsWidget`

Adding faction suffix to `Decorations` doesn't break CNC mod as `chrome.yaml` defines both [`scrollpanel-decorations-nod` and `scrollpanel-decorations-gdi`](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/blob/bleed/mods/cnc/chrome.yaml#L491).

Fixes #20619.

issue_context.title: ProductionTabsWidget: customizing production tabs
issue_context.body:
## Motivation

In a mod I'd like to customize production tabs in sidebar and I hit some limitations of `ProductionTabsWidget`.

More specifically:
1. being able to customize decoration for left/right buttons for scrolling
2. being able to customize and use separate background image for tab itself (and left/right arrows)

Problem with 1) lies with `getLeftArrowImage` and `getRightArrowImage` being resolved too early (in constructor) before `Decorations` can be set.
This can be solved in inherited class with reflection, i.e. generate new `CachedTransform` using `WidgetUtils.GetCachedStatefulImage` again in `Initialize` method
(when `Decorations` collection is set).

Problem with 2) lies with `ProductionTabsWidget.Draw` method using same collection (`Button`) for both right/left buttons and also for tab itself.
Modifying this method is not really possible without more reflection and copying body of that method from `ProductionTabsWidget`.

## Proposed solution

I propose following changes to `ProductionTabsWidget`

- for 1) move assigning `getLeftArrowImage` and `getRightArrowImage` from constructor to `Initialize` method
- for 2) use separate collection for drawing background of left/right arrows and background of production tabs (i.e. two separate fields).
    Plus use same collection `Button` by default to keep the same behavior.

## Side effects

The first change shouldn't have any side effect, since those fields are only used in `Draw`.

The second change also shouldn't have any side effect, since current behavior will be preserved.

## Alternatives

Alternative solution could be reimplementing `ProductionTabsWidget` and related classes (to accommodate for this change) for the mod, which I really would like to avoid.
